ITEM 1 | Mixed raw-looking dark green spinach-like leaves, mostly whole flat leaves with some torn edges, spread across the upper-left part of a white square plate covering roughly 25% of the plate; leaves are matte with slight sheen, interspersed with thin orange shredded strips, small dark red dried fruit pieces (about 0.5-1 cm), and a few pale tan slivers; sits beside the flatbread pieces | 60

ITEM 2 | Flat bread wedge, pale golden-tan with browned grill marks and dark charred spots along edges, soft-looking surface, roughly 7 cm by 4 cm, sits at the bottom-left of the greens on the plate, about 3% of plate area | 35

ITEM 3 | Sliced fresh tomato pieces, bright red-orange with slightly translucent flesh and glossy wet sheen, two to three thick slices about 5-6 cm across and 1 cm thick, lying on a browned flatbread base at the bottom center of the plate; some edges show seeds and slight charring | 70

ITEM 4 | Thin orange-red sauce or oily glaze visible as sheen across the tomato slices and bread surface, glossy and spread thinly, covering about 10 square cm | 8
